scenes.title: Ảo Tưởng Giờ Cao Điểm
scenes.text: Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm, thấy máy chạy bộ kín người, phòng tạ đông đúc và quầy lễ tân xếp hàng, ai cũng nghĩ đây là cỗ máy in tiền béo bở.
scenes.prompt: Minimalist 2D line art, stickman lifting explaining Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm, clean whiteboard explainer vector style, flat pastel background, 1080p.

beats.title: Ảo Tưởng Giờ Cao Điểm - Ý 1
beats.prompt: Minimalist 2D line art, stickman lifting explaining Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm, clean whiteboard explainer vector style, flat pastel background, 1080p.
beats.svg_data:
<svg width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <!-- Background flat pastel -->
      <rect width="1920" height="1080" fill="#F0FDF4" />
      
      <!-- Top header bar with scene & beat indicator -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1920" height="70" fill="rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.06)" />
      
      <g transform="translate(60, 20)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="160" height="34" rx="8" fill="#1E293B" />
        <text x="80" y="23" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="16" fill="#F8FAFC" text-anchor="middle">
          CẢNH 1/14
        </text>
      </g>

      <text x="240" y="44" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="22" fill="#334155">
        ẢO TƯỞNG GIỜ CAO ĐIỂM
      </text>

      <!-- Beat Timing Chip -->
      <g transform="translate(1560, 18)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="300" height="36" rx="10" fill="#F59E0B" />
        <text x="150" y="24" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="16" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
          Ý 1/4 • 2.0s (Đổi hình theo nhịp)
        </text>
      </g>

      <!-- Stickman Character matching the semantic pause -->
      
    <g transform="translate(220, 480)">
      <circle cx="100" cy="110" r="50" fill="#FDEDEC" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" />
      <ellipse cx="100" cy="130" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#E74C3C" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="3" />
      <line x1="-100" y1="30" x2="300" y2="30" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <rect x="-140" y="-10" width="35" height="80" rx="6" fill="#1E293B" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="5" />
      <rect x="300" y="-10" width="35" height="80" rx="6" fill="#1E293B" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="5" />
      <path d="M 100 180 L 20 100 L 0 35" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 100 180 L 180 100 L 200 35" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="100" y1="160" x2="100" y2="320" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 100 320 L 35 410 L 20 480" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 100 320 L 165 410 L 180 480" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </g>
  

      <!-- Centerpiece Visual Explainer Card -->
      <g transform="translate(740, 220)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1020" height="630" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="7" />
        
        <!-- Header Banner on Card -->
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1020" height="96" rx="26" fill="#D97706" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="6" />
        <text x="510" y="62" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing="1">
          🏋️ MÔ HÌNH VẬN HÀNH
        </text>

        <!-- Illustration Graphics inside Card -->
        <g transform="translate(60, 150)">
          <!-- Dynamic Thematic Icon Badge -->
          <circle cx="110" cy="110" r="75" fill="#F1F5F9" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="6" />
          <text x="110" y="135" font-size="70" text-anchor="middle">🏋️</text>

          <!-- Text block representing this specific sentence clause -->
          <g transform="translate(230, 20)">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="670" height="70" rx="14" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="3" />
            <text x="24" y="44" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="24" fill="#0F172A">
              ✨ Phân đoạn: Ảo Tưởng Giờ Cao Điểm (Nhịp 1)
            </text>

            <rect x="0" y="95" width="670" height="130" rx="14" fill="#F1F5F9" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="3" />
            <text x="24" y="145" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="23" fill="#1E293B">
              "Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm"
            </text>
            <text x="24" y="185" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="#64748B">
              ⏱ Thời lượng hiển thị khớp lời đọc: 2.0 giây
            </text>
          </g>
        </g>

        <!-- Bottom Feature Tag inside Card -->
        <rect x="60" y="500" width="900" height="85" rx="18" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="4" />
        <text x="510" y="552" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0F172A">
          🎯 Tự động chuyển đổi hình ảnh theo mốc thời gian ngắt ý của Voice TTS
        </text>
      </g>

      <!-- Bottom Subtitle Bar (Exact spoken clause) -->
      <g transform="translate(140, 930)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1640" height="100" rx="22" fill="rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94)" stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)" stroke-width="3" />
        <text x="820" y="62" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF">
          Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm
        </text>
      </g>
    </svg>
beats.caption: Đến phòng gym vào giờ cao điểm

<svg width="1920" height="1080" viewBox="0 0 1920 1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

      <g transform="translate(60, 20)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="160" height="34" rx="8" fill="#1E293B" />
        <text x="80" y="23" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="16" fill="#F8FAFC" text-anchor="middle">
          CẢNH 9/14
        </text>
      </g>

      <text x="240" y="44" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="22" fill="#334155">

      </text>

      <!-- Beat Timing Chip -->
      <g transform="translate(1560, 18)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="300" height="36" rx="10" fill="#4F46E5" />
        <text x="150" y="24" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="16" fill="#FFFFFF" text-anchor="middle">
          Ý 1/4 • 2.0s (Đổi hình theo nhịp)
        </text>
      </g>

      <!-- Stickman Character matching the semantic pause -->
      
    <g transform="translate(220, 480)">
      <circle cx="100" cy="100" r="50" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" />
      <circle cx="88" cy="90" r="6" fill="#232323" />
      <circle cx="118" cy="90" r="6" fill="#232323" />

      <line x1="100" y1="150" x2="100" y2="300" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 100 180 L 160 210 L 220 180" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <path d="M 100 180 L 50 230" fill="none" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="100" y1="300" x2="60" y2="440" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
      <line x1="100" y1="300" x2="140" y2="440" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" />
    </g>
  

      <!-- Centerpiece Visual Explainer Card -->
      <g transform="translate(740, 220)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1020" height="630" rx="30" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="7" />
        
        <!-- Header Banner on Card -->
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1020" height="96" rx="26" fill="#4338CA" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="6" />
        <text x="510" y="62" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="900" font-size="34" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" letter-spacing="1">
          💡 TRỌNG TÂM PHÂN TÍCH
        </text>

        <!-- Illustration Graphics inside Card -->
        <g transform="translate(60, 150)">
          <!-- Dynamic Thematic Icon Badge -->
          <circle cx="110" cy="110" r="75" fill="#F1F5F9" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="6" />
          <text x="110" y="135" font-size="70" text-anchor="middle">💡</text>

          <!-- Text block representing this specific sentence clause -->
          <g transform="translate(230, 20)">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="670" height="70" rx="14" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="3" />
            <text x="24" y="44" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="800" font-size="24" fill="#0F172A">
              ✨ Phân đoạn: Nhượng Quyền Hay Tự Mở? (Nhịp 1)
            </text>

            <rect x="0" y="95" width="670" height="130" rx="14" fill="#F1F5F9" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="3" />
            <text x="24" y="145" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="23" fill="#1E293B">
              "Nhượng quyền mang lại thương hiệu nhưng"
            </text>
            <text x="24" y="185" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="#64748B">
              ⏱ Thời lượng hiển thị khớp lời đọc: 2.0 giây
            </text>
          </g>
        </g>

        <!-- Bottom Feature Tag inside Card -->
        <rect x="60" y="500" width="900" height="85" rx="18" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#232323" stroke-width="4" />
        <text x="510" y="552" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="22" text-anchor="middle" fill="#0F172A">
          🎯 Tự động chuyển đổi hình ảnh theo mốc thời gian ngắt ý của Voice TTS
        </text>
      </g>

      <!-- Bottom Subtitle Bar (Exact spoken clause) -->
      <g transform="translate(140, 930)">
        <rect x="0" y="0" width="1640" height="100" rx="22" fill="rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.94)" stroke="rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)" stroke-width="3" />
        <text x="820" y="62" font-family="-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif" font-weight="700" font-size="26" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF">
          Nhượng quyền mang lại thương hiệu nhưng
        </text>
      </g>
    </svg>
